question: Where does the off-catalogue surrogate truth sit physically? (H-BASIN test)
preregistered: H-BASIN: surrogate truth hides under basin fill (flat, deep cover)
verdict: FALSIFIED: the surrogate truth is steep, shallow-cover range structure (58% in the steepest slope quartile vs 25% uniform; 1.3% in the flattest), the opposite of the basin-fill prediction. The catalogue's incompleteness visible to SGMC is range structure not in the Quaternary catalogue.

also_measured.question: why did slope-ranked emission lose to random on the surrogate
also_measured.verdict: top-k slope emission overshoots the truth's value range (emits cliffs where truth is moderate slope) and under-covers (49.2% vs 79.1%): both effects favour spreading, quantified in evidence/coverage_emission.json
